jobs.title: Senior .NET / Java Developer
jobs.description:
| WHO ARE WE?

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings its expertise to clients to help them meet their challenges. For 25 years, with a presence in 16 countries, we have built a reputation for excellence and reliability through Employeneurship across various fields: Technology & Engineering / Energy & Renewables / Life Sciences & Pharma / Digital & IT.
| YOUR CHALLENGE?

We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer with Java experience
to join an existing squad at one of our major clients in Brussels.
Within an agile team, you will design and build the authentication and authorization services that other applications rely on:
Develop, test and document software components, libraries and services for user authentication and authorization.
Build and document sample applications and code snippets showing how to integrate these services into legacy and new applications.
Configure and develop code extensions for off-the-shelf solutions (access manager, authorization engine, API gateway, reverse proxy, directory service) and custom components.
Improve continuous integration and deployment through automation and configuration management.
Work with IT teams and other project teams to understand their technical needs and integration issues.
Deploy commercial and open-source products by following technical documentation and installation guides.

| WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

Strong knowledge of C#, .NET and Java, REST, JSON and YAML, plus JavaScript scripting.
UI development experience with Vue.js and Blazor.
Data storage experience with LDAP and SQL Server.
Solid knowledge of OAuth2 and OIDC, and of web security concepts (HTTPS, cookies, CORS, Single Sign-On, MFA).
Understanding of cryptographic concepts (symmetric and asymmetric keys).
Cloud experience with Kubernetes and AKS, plus Git and DevOps practices.
A plus: TypeScript, PowerShell, Bash, React, SAML2, PKI, hash functions and keystores, an IDP platform (ADFS, Keycloak, Ping, Okta, EntraID), and a microservices architecture background.
Good level of English, and of Dutch and/or French.

| WHAT IS EMPLOYENEURSHIP?

It is built around 5 main pillars:
A permanent employment contract, offering stability and security;
Full transparency: know your financial value and receive an individual share of the profits you help generate;
Individual coaching designed to develop your entrepreneurial skills;
Competence cells that give you a strong, meaningful and relevant network;
The entrepreneurial laboratory: a playground for new ideas and a potential launchpad for start-ups.

jobs.title: AllPhi enables the next generation – Become the Software Consultant who makes an impact!
jobs.description:
At AllPhi, we are the destination for talented consultants
with a solid foundation in software development and a broad view of modern technology. Our focus on growth, coaching, training, and strategic consultancy projects
helps software professionals evolve into full-fledged consultants
who make a real impact for our clients.

Due to our continued growth, we are looking for driven Full Stack Consultants
to strengthen our team. Our core belief, "AllPhi enables the next generation software developers",
is the foundation of your success!

What does the role entail?

As a Full Stack Consultant
at AllPhi, you are more than a developer, you are a shaper of digital innovation, a creative thinker who designs, builds, and delivers high-quality software solutions.
You work side by side with our clients on diverse projects, from web applications to cloud integrations, combining strong technical expertise with a consultancy mindset
.

More and more of our projects involve AI integrations
. That’s why at AllPhi you’ll have the opportunity to explore AI, data, and automation
, and to learn how these technologies empower the software solutions of tomorrow.

Your daily challenge is to design, create, and refine applications that seamlessly align with our clients’
business strategies. From analysis to implementation, you take ownership of your work, think along with the client, and help build solutions that are scalable, high-performing, and future-proof.

Your skills:

We value passionate Full Stack Consultants
with at least 4 to 5 years of relevant professional experience
within the Microsoft stack
, and a strong drive for continuous growth.
You are naturally curious about everything happening in the .NET, cloud, front-end, and AI landscape
, and have a genuine interest in the consultancy profession
.

Technical Expertise:
Solid experience with C#, Entity Framework, and SQL Server. Skilled in developing scalable applications and familiar with Azure Cloud (other cloud platforms are a plus).
Front-end Affinity:
Strong knowledge of Angular
. Experience with React, Blazor, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and other front-end technologies is a plus.
AI & Innovation:
Interest in learning how AI technologies
and data integrations
play a role in modern Microsoft solutions.
Consultancy Mindset:
You think along with the client, ask the right questions, and translate needs into technical solutions with business impact.
Collaboration and Communication:
A strong team player with excellent communication skills in Dutch and English
(French is a plus).
Passion for Technology:
You stay up to date with new trends, enjoy sharing knowledge, and draw energy from continuous improvement.

What we offer:

In addition to a competitive gross salary, we offer an extensive package of fringe benefits, including a company car with fuel card, expense allowance, meal vouchers, eco vouchers, group insurance, hospitalization insurance, mobile phone subscription, smartphone budget, a laptop, a Flexible Income Plan (cafeteria plan), and 20 statutory vacation days plus 12 additional days (ADV).

Where to find us:

AllPhi Westerlo - Gebouw 4Wings - Nijverheidsstraat 13, 2260 Westerlo
AllPhi Gent - Axxes Business Park - Gebouw G, Guldensporenpark 24, 9820 Merelbeke
AllPhi Brussel - Park 7 – Gebouw Onyx, Hermeslaan 9, 1831 Machelen.

jobs.description:
For our international pharma client we are looking for an EI&C Software Application Engineer (m/f/d).

Workload: 100%
Location: Visp
5 days per week onsite
Duration: 12 months (possibility of extension)

Key Responsibilities

Develop, configure, and maintain automation and manufacturing software applications.
Design, implement, and integrate solutions connected to DCS, MES, historians, databases, and related manufacturing systems.
Develop software solutions using technologies such as VBA, PowerShell, C#, SQL, and Git-based version control systems.
Create software design specifications, functional specifications, and other engineering documentation in accordance with GMP and company standards.
Support system interfaces, data exchange, and integration between OT and IT platforms.
Execute software testing, commissioning, qualification, and deployment activities.
Participate in troubleshooting, root cause investigations, and resolution of software and system issues.
Maintain and enhance existing applications to improve reliability, performance, and user experience.

Experience with automation and manufacturing systems such as DCS, MES, or data historian platforms.
Knowledge of programming and scripting languages including VBA, PowerShell, C#, and SQL.
Understanding of software lifecycle management and application support.
Experience working in GMP-regulated environments and creating GxP-compliant documentation.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Fluent English and/or German.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences manufacturing.
Knowledge of DeltaV, Syncade, PI System, or similar industrial software platforms.
Familiarity with software validation, CSV/CSA methodologies, and data integrity requirements.
Understanding of OT infrastructure and cybersecurity principles.

DCS & MES Integration

.
